I have identified the outbound delivery function and its protection mechanism. I am now formulating the exact response.

The delivery function is `Post` in `internal/webhook/webhook.go`. It executes the HTTP POST via `safeClient.Do(req)`. The flow begins at `memo_service_webhooks.go` where `PostAsync` enqueues to `asyncPostQueue`, then worker goroutines call `Post` to perform the actual request.

The protection mechanism has two layers. `ValidateURL` in `validate.go` rejects URLs whose hostnames resolve to non-reserved IPs during configuration. At delivery time, `safeDialContext` in `webhook.go` blocks reserved private IPs via `isReservedIP` from `validate.go`; this also prevents DNS rebinding.

`ValidateURL` is also invoked in `user_service_webhooks.go` when webhooks are created or updated.

message.text:
I am identifying the outbound delivery function and its protection mechanism.

The outbound delivery executes in `Post` within `internal/webhook/webhook.go`. The protection mechanisms are `safeDialContext` in that same file, and `ValidateURL` plus `isReservedIP` in `internal/webhook/validate.go`.

`safeDialContext` in `internal/webhook/webhook.go` is the primary execution-time guard against internal network addresses. `ValidateURL` in `internal/webhook/validate.go` prevents misconfiguration by blocking reserved IPs during registration.

h02.

**Post** — `internal/webhook/webhook.go`; **safeDialContext** — `internal/webhook/webhook.go`

When content changes, dispatch is queued from `server/router/api/v1/memo_service_webhooks.go` via `webhook.PostAsync`, but the actual outbound HTTP POST runs in **`Post`**, which sends the request with `safeClient.Do(req)` (`internal/webhook/webhook.go`).

That client’s transport uses **`safeDialContext`**, which resolves the target host and rejects any address in a reserved/private range via **`isReservedIP`** (defined in `internal/webhook/validate.go`). That blocks SSRF and DNS rebinding at dial time. Webhook URLs are also checked at registration time by **`ValidateURL`** in `internal/webhook/validate.go`.
